test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

She is ______ , always submits her assignments on time.
solution: The correct answer is **"punctual."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Punctual"** means being on time or prompt. (सही समय पर कुछ करने या होने वाला, वक़्त का पाबंद, समय पालक; विलंब न करने वाला, समयनिष्‍ठ) • It is the opposite of **"late"** or** "tardy."** • **Example**: *She is **punctual**__, always submits her assignments on time.* • The given sentence talks about the submission of assignment, so the correct word is **"punctual."** Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 2". **Correct sentence**: *She is __**punctual**__ , always submits her assignments on time.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (late)** means not on time, delayed. (सामान्‍य या प्रत्‍याशित समय के बाद; विलंब से) • **Option 3 (scheduled)** means planned or arranged for a certain time. (एक विशेष समय पर घटित होने की योजना बनाई गई) • **Option 4 (tardy)** means arriving or doing something late. (धीमा, सुस्त; सामान्य, निर्धारित या अपेक्षित समय के बाद होनेवाला) 38:Ta04, The correct answer is **"His performance exceeded all expectations."**
